title: withBandGeometry
description: Updates part of one cluster's band geometry without mutating the input or affecting other clusters' state.
signature: function withBandGeometry(byCluster: BandGeometryByCluster, clusterId: string | null, patch: Partial<BandGeometry>): BandGeometryByCluster
semantics: Merges the patch into one cluster's entry, returning a new immutable map; no-op when clusterId is null.
